faq_section.title: Essay Extender FAQ
faq_section.description: How the tool works, what it does with your text, and what to expect from the results.

items.title: How does the target word count work?
items.description: You set the total length you want — any whole number above your current word count, up to 3,000. The extender expands your draft toward that total and reports the actual, target, and added word counts. Treat the result as very close to the target rather than an exact match.

items.title: Which languages can I use?
items.description: By default the expanded essay follows the language of your draft: an English draft stays English, a Spanish draft stays Spanish. You can also pick a fixed output language from the dropdown if you want the result in another language.

items.title: What do tone and expansion focus do?
items.description: Tone sets how the essay sounds — academic, natural, or formal. Focus sets where the growth goes: balanced expansion, deeper development of existing ideas, concrete examples, or smoother flow and transitions.

items.title: Is my draft text private?
items.description: Yes. The essay extender sends your pasted draft to generate the expansion and does not save it to your account or our database. Only anonymous usage counts are recorded — never your text or the generated result.

items.title: Will it invent citations or facts?
items.description: No. The extender is instructed not to invent quotations, citations, studies, statistics, names, or facts. It elaborates with reasoning, restatement, and clearly grounded examples instead. Always verify factual claims before submitting academic work.

items.title: Is the essay extender free?
items.description: Yes. The tool works within a daily fair-use limit, and signing in gives you more daily expansions.
